title: More ways to generate text
summary:
New text models and a prompt-to-HTML Worker arrived, while community tools joined the directory and the text cache got more precise.

Added `openai-fast` with text and image input, plus `mirexa`, an in-character persona that can produce image prompts. The `openai` alias now points to GPT-4.1-mini, and `deepseek-reasoning` uses MAI-DS-R1 with a conversational default prompt.

Added a websim Worker that takes a prompt from a URL and returns generated, self-contained HTML directly rather than an event stream.

The project listings now include Polynate, a text-and-audio generation interface, and Pollinations Task Master, a Task Master fork with CLI and MCP interfaces. Two PRs updated Polynate’s listing.

highlights.title: A faster OpenAI option
highlights.text: Use `openai-fast` for GPT-4.1-nano with text and image input; `openai-small` is an alias. The existing `openai` model now maps to GPT-4.1-mini. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-fast).

highlights.title: Meet Mirexa
highlights.text: Chat with `mirexa`, an in-character persona that can write image prompts using `<t2i>` tags. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mirexa).

highlights.title: Prompts into HTML pages
highlights.text: A new websim Worker takes a prompt from the URL and returns a self-contained HTML page directly.
